ui.backupTitle: An encrypted copy you can restore
ui.backupHelp: This file includes all ten fields, even sections hidden in care mode. It is encrypted locally. Choose a unique passphrase of 12–128 characters, preferably several random words. There is no password recovery. The passphrase is not saved or sent. Backup and restore need a secure connection and browser encryption support; the form and print remain available without them.
ui.fileLabel: Choose an encrypted backup (up to 96 KiB)
ui.backupUnavailable: Encrypted backup and restore are unavailable in this browser or connection. Your form and print remain available.
ui.backupBusy: Working locally. You can keep editing; Clear cancels delivery of this result.
ui.backupError: Could not process this backup. Check the file and passphrase, or retry if the folder changed. Your current folder has not been replaced.
ui.backupSaved: Encrypted download requested. Your browser decides where to save it.
ui.backupCandidate: Backup verified. Confirm only if you want to replace all current fields, including hidden sections.
ui.backupCancelled: Restore cancelled. Your current folder is unchanged.
ui.eyebrow: A little preparation, kept with you
ui.title: A family folder for the person stepping in
ui.intro: Write down what someone would need to know if you were unavailable. Everything stays on this open page until you print it or clear it.
ui.limitHint: Optional fields. Up to 1,000 characters each; no passwords or payment codes.
ui.limitError: Use no more than 1,000 characters per field and valid Unicode text. Nothing has been shortened. Fix this field before continuing.
ui.outputTitle: Keep a copy you can use
ui.printPrivacy: The printed document and PDF are not encrypted. Choose Save as PDF in your browser's print dialog if you want a file. This page cannot confirm that you saved it.
ui.familySummary: Preview: all filled sections. Empty sections are omitted.
ui.careSummary: Preview: contacts, home and care only. Documents and accounts remain in this page but are excluded from this handover.
ui.clearConfirm: Clear all ten fields? This page does not keep a copy.
ui.requestHelp: Opens GitHub, where an account is required. Enter your country there and submit the issue yourself. None of your folder is included.
ui.privacy: No account, upload or autosave. Your entries stay in page memory, are never sent or stored, and disappear on reload. Keep any printed copies privately.
ui.metrics: Only fixed counts of opened/reviewed sections, print requests and encrypted download requests are sent. No entries, country, mode, contact details or visitor ID are included in those events.
ui.adviceLimit: A personal checklist, not medical or legal advice. Record where trusted instructions can be found, not treatment prescriptions or service passwords.
ui.loadError: Unable to load the page. Your entries have not been sent. Reload to try again.
